text:
elaine: Quick postmortem follow-up from the midnight GPU exhaustion incident. We split remediation into three owners: quota backstop, scheduler tuning, and headroom/runway tooling. Assigning now so these don't drift.

marco: I'll own the quota backstop. Plan: implement a small control-plane lambda that enforces a soft reserve per-pool and a hard failover threshold. Soft reserve = 12% for interactive pools, with alert at 88% and page at 94% for 5m. ETA: 5 business days.

tara: I'll take scheduler tuning. Immediate goal: reduce background job packing aggressiveness and add a 30s damp window after eviction so we don't re-pack thrash. I'll run a 7-day arrival trace sim and post p50/p95/p99.

elaine: tara, also add a change to eviction scoring: prefer `score = mem_frac*1.5 + cpu_frac*0.7 + age_secs*0.0005` and test it in staging.

marco: acceptance test snippet for quota backstop:

```
# acceptance test
spike(batch_qps=4x, duration=900s)
assert(reserved_pct(interactive) >= 12%)
expect(alert='quota_soft', within=120s)
expect(pager='quota_hard', if=sustained(>94%, 300s))
```

infra-sre-bot: Created follow-up tasks: F-901 (quota-backstop-lambda), F-902 (scheduler-damp-and-score), F-903 (headroom-runway-card). Links: https://redwood.internal/remediations/F-901 etc.

elaine: headroom tooling: we want a "predicted runway" card in ops that shows linear and AR(2) predictions for 1h and 6h. Tara, can you wire a simple linear column first and mark model output as experimental?

tara: yes. I'll add linear forecast in the card and flag model_preds. Target: linear column live in ops by next Tue; model preds after we validate.

marco: blocker: the control-plane needs per-pool live reserved_pct from the metrics API. @infra-sre can you expose reserved_pct and active_gpu_jobs_count?

infra-sre-bot: Will add metrics: pool.reserved_pct, pool.active_gpu_jobs, pool.avg_mem_frac(1m/5m). API PR planned by EOD tomorrow.

elaine: owners + due dates recap: marco -> F-901 quota-backstop (due 2024-07-10), tara -> F-902 scheduler changes + sims (due 2024-07-08), infra -> F-903 runway metrics + ops card (due 2024-07-09). I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups and assign in the remediation board.

marco: small note on failover: if hard threshold triggers and preemptive scale not possible, we should redirect background batch to a delayed queue rather than deny interactive traffic. I'll add a tiny queuing shim in the lambda.

tara: perf measurement checklist: p50/p95/p99 for interactive and batch, token-cost delta, and pack/unpack latency. Will post numbers in thread.

ops-bot: Reminder: link postmortem follow-ups: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1748001111. Action items filed: #F-901, #F-902, #F-903.

elaine: one-process rule: add the follow-ups section to the postmortem doc and set weekly review for 3 weeks to ensure closure. Also create a Monday SRE headroom check assigned to oncall.

marco: I'll add the acceptance tests to CI so we can gate merges.

tara: potential blocker: we need historical per-job mem_frac histograms to tune the new eviction weights. @infra-sre can you backfill 45 days?

infra-sre-bot: Backfill scheduled; ETA 4 hours. Will post when complete.

elaine: perfect. let's reconvene in 3 business days with simulation results and the PR links. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
